package curriculum

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

type DiagnosticGateway interface {
	EnsureDiagnosticPlacement(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary, error)
	GetDiagnosticPlanningState(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticPlanningState, error)
}

// Diagnostic orchestrates owner projections; completion never submits planning.
type Diagnostic struct {
	Gateway  DiagnosticGateway
	Overview repository.StudentLearnerOverviewReader
	Plans    LearningPlanner
}

func (d Diagnostic) Complete(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error) {
	return d.state(ctx, studentID, planID, false)
}

func (d Diagnostic) Plan(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error) {
	return d.state(ctx, studentID, planID, true)
}

func (d Diagnostic) state(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string, submit bool) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error) {
	result := domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState{Schema: "teacher-diagnostic-placement-state.v1", PlanID: planID}
	student, studentErr := uuid.Parse(studentID)
	plan, planErr := uuid.Parse(planID)
	if studentErr != nil || planErr != nil || student.String() != studentID || plan.String() != planID {
		return result, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum
	}
	if d.Gateway == nil || d.Overview == nil || (submit && d.Plans == nil) {
		return result, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	placement, err := d.Gateway.EnsureDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, studentID, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	result.Placement = placement
	state, err := d.Gateway.GetDiagnosticPlanningState(ctx, studentID, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	result.GoalCode = state.GoalCode
	// Existing accepted jobs are historical facts; profile changes cannot rewrite them.
	if state.Request != nil && (!submit || state.Request.Status != "FAILED" || state.Request.FailureCode != "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED") {
		return d.project(ctx, studentID, result, state.Request)
	}
	overview, err := d.Overview.GetLearnerOverview(ctx, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return result, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	if overview.StudentID != studentID || overview.Onboarding == nil {
		return result, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	profile := overview.Onboarding
	if profile.GoalCode != state.GoalCode || profile.Version != state.OnboardingVersion || profile.DirectionCode != state.DirectionCode {
		result.Status, result.FailureCode = "DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT_STALE", "DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT_STALE"
		return result, nil
	}
	result.Status = "READY_FOR_PLANNING"
	if !submit {
		return result, nil
	}
	_, err = d.Plans.CreateCoursePlan(ctx, PlanInput{StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: planID, DiagnosticPlanID: planID,
		GoalCode: state.GoalCode, DesiredOutcome: "Build my initial learning path after diagnostic", Reason: PlanReasonInitial})
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	state, err = d.Gateway.GetDiagnosticPlanningState(ctx, studentID, planID)
	if err != nil || state.Request == nil {
		return result, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	return d.project(ctx, studentID, result, state.Request)
}

func (d Diagnostic) project(ctx context.Context, studentID string, result domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, request *domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest) (domain.TeacherDiagnosticPlacementState, error) {
	result.PlannerRequestID = request.RequestID
	switch request.Status {
	case "REQUESTED", "PLANNING":
		result.Status = "PLANNING_PENDING"
	case "FAILED":
		result.PlanningRetryable = request.FailureCode == "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED"
		result.Status, result.FailureCode = "PLANNING_FAILED", request.FailureCode
		if request.FailureCode == "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID" {
			result.Status = "DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT_STALE"
		}
	case "COMPLETED":
		if request.LearningPathID == "" {
			if request.ResultCode != "NO_GAP" {
				return result, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
			}
			result.Status = "NO_GAP"
		} else {
			overview, err := d.Overview.GetLearnerOverview(ctx, studentID)
			if err != nil || overview.StudentID != studentID || overview.LearningPath == nil || overview.LearningPath.StudentID != studentID || overview.LearningPath.ID != request.LearningPathID || overview.LearningPath.Status != "ACTIVE" {
				return result, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
			}
			result.Status, result.LearningPathID = "LEARNING_PATH_ACTIVE", request.LearningPathID
		}
	default:
		return result, domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	}
	return result, nil
}
